moves.subject: brand
moves.move: Set a demand baseline: three tracked signals (e.g. branded search, sell-through rate, retailer reorder) with a fixed start date
moves.horizon: Baseline in 6 weeks · direction visible within two quarters
moves.metric: Tracked demand signals moving against a fixed baseline; decisions traced to the definition
moves.outcomeEvidence: Illustrative: demand baseline live since March; branded search +18% and retailer reorder rate up two points over two quarters, documented in the quarterly pack.

moves.metric: Renewals decided against written criteria, and exits executed on schedule
